newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Retailing, Symbol in pact.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Retailing, Symbol in pact.

text.p: Electronic Retailing Systems International Inc said Wednesday it has signed a strategic partner agreement with Symbol Technologies Inc.

The company said the pact calls for Symbol to distribute and support Electronic's wireless electronic shelf label systems, equipment and management applications software in conjunction with Symbol's hand-held portable data entry products and Portable Shopper Self Checkout System on an exclusive basis in Europe and on a selected basis throughout the remainder of the world.
Electronic said it and Symbol will jointly dedicate technical resources to design and develop marketing strategies and customized software applications and interfaces for retail enterprise solutions.
